package rulefixtures

import (
	"net/http"
	gorm "gorm.io/gorm"
)

// scenario for order_by_random_request_path: ORDER BY RAND()/RANDOM() observed on request paths.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: data_access; severity: contextual.

type Quote struct {
	ID   int
	Text string
}

func RandomQuoteHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request, db *gorm.DB) {
	var quote Quote
	db.Order("RANDOM()").First(&quote)
	w.Write([]byte(quote.Text))
}
